    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Spring AI Alibaba -- 文生图、文生音及向量化</span>

            <div class="postBody">

<h1 id="chatmemory对话记忆">ChatMemory对话记忆</h1>
<p>ChatMemory（Spring AI 里的聊天记忆接口）。</p>
<p>LLM 本身是<strong>无状态</strong>的，你单独发一句消息，它不知道上一轮聊了啥。<code>ChatMemory</code> 就是 Spring AI 提供的<strong>会话上下文管理器</strong>，用来保存当前对话的消息列表，每次请求自动把历史消息塞给大模型，实现连续对话。</p>
<p>由于大模型本身不存储数据，服务一重启，记忆的信息就丢失了，所以必须持久化。</p>
<h2 id="四种记忆类型">四种记忆类型</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>内存存储</p>
<p>用于开发和测试的简单内存存储。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>持久化存储</p>
<p>用于生产环境的数据库支持存储。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>分布式存储</p>
<p>用于可扩展应用程序的分布式存储。</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>自定义存储</p>
<p>用于特定需求的自定义存储实现。</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="记忆持久化案例">记忆持久化案例</h2>
<p>需求：将客户和大模型的对话问答保存进Redis进行持久化存储。</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>新建一个module ，pom文件为</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?&gt;
&lt;project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"&gt;
    &lt;modelVersion&gt;4.0.0&lt;/modelVersion&gt;
    &lt;parent&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.ali&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;springAiAlibaba-workV1&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;version&gt;1.0-SNAPSHOT&lt;/version&gt;
    &lt;/parent&gt;

    &lt;artifactId&gt;saa08-persistent&lt;/artifactId&gt;

    &lt;properties&gt;
        &lt;maven.compiler.source&gt;17&lt;/maven.compiler.source&gt;
        &lt;maven.compiler.target&gt;17&lt;/maven.compiler.target&gt;
        &lt;project.build.sourceEncoding&gt;UTF-8&lt;/project.build.sourceEncoding&gt;
    &lt;/properties&gt;
    &lt;dependencies&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.boot&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-boot-starter-web&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;com.alibaba.cloud.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;org.projectlombok&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;lombok&lt;/artifactId&gt;
            &lt;optional&gt;true&lt;/optional&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;com.alibaba.cloud.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-alibaba-starter-memory-redis&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;redis.clients&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;jedis&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;org.projectlombok&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;lombok&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;/dependencies&gt;
&lt;/project&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置文件内容</p>
<pre><code class="language-properties">server.port=8008
# ?????????
server.servlet.encoding.charset=UTF-8
server.servlet.encoding.enabled=true
server.servlet.encoding.force=true

spring.application.name=saa08-persistent

#springai ????config
spring.ai.dashscope.api-key=${aliQwen-apikey}

#redis config
spring.data.redis.host=localhost
spring.data.redis.port=6379
spring.data.redis.connect-timeout=3
spring.data.redis.database=0
spring.data.redis.timeout=2
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置类（2个）</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
public class RedisMemoryConfig {

    @Value("${spring.data.redis.host}")
    private String host;

    @Value("${spring.data.redis.port}")
    private int port;

    @Bean
    public RedisChatMemoryRepository getRedisChatMemoryRepository() {
        return RedisChatMemoryRepository.builder()
                .host(host).port(port).build();
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<pre><code class="language-java">@Configuration
public class SaaLLMConfig {

    private final String DEEPSEEk_MODEL="deepseek-v3";
    private final String QWEN_MODEL="qwen-max";

    // 方式一
    @Value("${spring.ai.dashscope.api-key}")
    private String apiKey;

    // 配置大模型对外暴露的api
    @Bean(name = "deepseekChatModel")
    public ChatModel deepseekChatModel() {
    return DashScopeChatModel.builder()
            // 配置apikey
            .dashScopeApi(DashScopeApi.builder().apiKey(apiKey).build())
            // 配置模型
            .defaultOptions(DashScopeChatOptions.builder().withModel(DEEPSEEk_MODEL).build())
            .build();
    }

    @Bean(name = "qwenChatModel")
    public ChatModel qwenChatModel() {
        return DashScopeChatModel.builder()
                // 配置apikey
                .dashScopeApi(DashScopeApi.builder().apiKey(apiKey).build())
                // 配置模型
                .defaultOptions(DashScopeChatOptions.builder().withModel(QWEN_MODEL).build())
                .build();
    }

    @Bean(name = "deepseekChatClient")
    public ChatClient deepseekChatClient(@Qualifier("deepseekChatModel") ChatModel deepseekChatModel,
                                         RedisChatMemoryRepository redisChatMemoryRepository) {
        // 配置消息窗口记忆，最多保留10条消息
        MessageWindowChatMemory messageWindowChatMemory = MessageWindowChatMemory.builder()
                .chatMemoryRepository(redisChatMemoryRepository)
                .maxMessages(10)
                .build();
        return ChatClient.builder(deepseekChatModel)
                .defaultAdvisors(MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.builder(messageWindowChatMemory).build())
                .build();
    }

    @Bean("qwenChatClient")
    public ChatClient qwenChatClient(@Qualifier("qwenChatModel") ChatModel qwenChatModel,
                                     RedisChatMemoryRepository redisChatMemoryRepository)  {
        // 配置消息窗口记忆，最多保留10条消息
        MessageWindowChatMemory messageWindowChatMemory = MessageWindowChatMemory.builder()
                .chatMemoryRepository(redisChatMemoryRepository)
                .maxMessages(10)
                .build();
        return ChatClient.builder(qwenChatModel)
                .defaultAdvisors(MessageChatMemoryAdvisor.builder(messageWindowChatMemory).build())
                .build();
    }
}
</code></pre>
<ol start="4">
<li>
<p>控制类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class ChatMemoryController {

    @Resource(name = "deepseekChatClient")
    private ChatClient deepseekChatClient;

    @Resource(name = "qwenChatClient")
    private ChatClient qwenChatClient;

    /**
     * 对话记忆
     *
     * @param
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping("/chatmemory/chat")
    public String chat(@RequestParam("msg") String msg,
                       @RequestParam("userId") String userId) {

       return qwenChatClient.prompt(msg).advisors(new Consumer&lt;ChatClient.AdvisorSpec&gt;() {
            // 顾问增强器
            @Override
            public void accept(ChatClient.AdvisorSpec advisorSpec) {
                advisorSpec.param("conversationId", userId);
            }
        }).call().content();
    }


    /**
     * 对话记忆
     *
     * @param
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping("/chatmemory/chat2")
    public String chat2(@RequestParam("msg") String msg,
                       @RequestParam("userId") String userId) {

        // 顾问增强器
        return qwenChatClient.prompt(msg).advisors(advisorSpec -&gt; advisorSpec.param("conversationId", userId))
                .call().content();
    }
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
<p>此时对话内容就保存到Redis中。</p>
<h1 id="文生图">文生图</h1>
<p>大模型一般使用阿里的Qwen-Image 或者Wan系列（通义万相）。</p>
<h2 id="代码示例">代码示例</h2>
<p>这里的pom文件和配置文件使用上一篇的基础配置。</p>
<p>控制类如下：</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class Text2ImageController {

    public static final String IMAGE_MODEL = "wanx2.1-t2i-turbo";

    @Resource
    private ImageModel imageModel;



    /**
     * 文生图
     * @param
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping("/test2image/image")
    public String image(@RequestParam(name="msg",defaultValue = "刺猬") String msg) {

        return imageModel.call(
                        new ImagePrompt(msg, DashScopeImageOptions.builder().withModel(IMAGE_MODEL).build())
                )
                .getResult()
                .getOutput()
                .getUrl();

    }

}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="文生音">文生音</h1>
<p>使用语音合成模型CosyVoice；音色使用longyingcui</p>
<p>直接给出控制类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class Text2VoiceController {

    // 文生音模型
    public static final String VOICE_MODEL = "cosyvoice-v2";
    // 音色选择
    public static final String VOICE_TIMBER = "longyingcui";

    @Resource
    private SpeechSynthesisModel speechSynthesisModel;



    /**
     * 文生音
     * @param
     * @return
     */
    @GetMapping("/test2voice/voice")
    public String voice(@RequestParam(name="msg",defaultValue = "您的美团外卖已自动为您接单了！") String msg) {
        String filePath = "d:/"+ UUID.randomUUID().toString()+".mp3";
        // 语音参数设置
        DashScopeSpeechSynthesisOptions options = DashScopeSpeechSynthesisOptions.builder()
                .voice(VOICE_TIMBER)
                .model(VOICE_MODEL)
                .build();
        // 调用文生音接口
       SpeechSynthesisResponse response = speechSynthesisModel.call(new SpeechSynthesisPrompt(msg, options));
       // 字节流语音转换
        ByteBuffer audioData = response.getResult().getOutput().getAudio();
        // 将字节流写入文件
        FileOutputStream fos = null;
        try {
            fos = new FileOutputStream(filePath);
            fos.write(audioData.array());
            fos.close();
        } catch (Exception e) {
            e.printStackTrace();
        }
        return filePath;

    }

}
</code></pre>
<h1 id="向量化">向量化</h1>
<p>向量：表示具有大小和方向的量。</p>
<h2 id="文本向量化">文本向量化</h2>
<p>嵌入模型：Embedding Model</p>
<p><strong>嵌入模型就是专门用来做文本向量化的 AI 模型</strong>，输入文本，输出一组向量（嵌入向量 /embedding），核心目标是把语义信息编码进向量里。</p>
<p>嵌入的工作原理就是将文本、图形、视频转换为向量的浮点数数组。</p>
<p><img alt="1-5" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3388489/202610/3388489-20261023142843407-1495749685.jpg" class="lazyload"></p>
<h2 id="向量数据库">向量数据库</h2>
<p>专门用于存储、管理和检索向量的数据库系统。</p>
<p>向量数据库维度越高，查询精准度也越高，查询效果越好。</p>
<p>常用的向量数据库有Elasticsearch、Neo4j、OceanBase、PGvector、Redis Stack等</p>
<p><strong>Redis Stack = 原生 Redis + 一套官方扩展模块打包在一起的发行版</strong>，除了普通 Redis 的缓存能力，自带<strong>RediSearch（检索 + 向量搜索）</strong>。</p>
<p>Redis 8.0 之后官方已经把这些模块内置进原版 Redis，Redis Stack 这个独立包标记为弃用了，新项目直接用 Redis 8+ 即可。</p>
<p>作用：</p>
<p>将文本    、图像、视频转换为向量，存储在数据库中。他们执行相似性搜索，而不是精确匹配。当给定一个向量做为查询时，VectorStore 返回与查询向量“相似”的向量。</p>
<ol>
<li>
<p>捕捉复杂词汇关系（语义相似性、同义词、多义词）</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>向量嵌入为检索增强生成（RAG）应用程序提供支持</p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 id="代码示例-1">代码示例</h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>新建一个module，pom为：</p>
<pre><code class="language-xml">&lt;?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?&gt;
&lt;project xmlns="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0"
         xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
         xsi:schemaLocation="http://maven.apache.org/POM/4.0.0 http://maven.apache.org/xsd/maven-4.0.0.xsd"&gt;
    &lt;modelVersion&gt;4.0.0&lt;/modelVersion&gt;
    &lt;parent&gt;
        &lt;groupId&gt;com.ali&lt;/groupId&gt;
        &lt;artifactId&gt;springAiAlibaba-workV1&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;version&gt;1.0-SNAPSHOT&lt;/version&gt;
    &lt;/parent&gt;

    &lt;artifactId&gt;saa11-Embed2vector&lt;/artifactId&gt;

    &lt;properties&gt;
        &lt;maven.compiler.source&gt;17&lt;/maven.compiler.source&gt;
        &lt;maven.compiler.target&gt;17&lt;/maven.compiler.target&gt;
        &lt;project.build.sourceEncoding&gt;UTF-8&lt;/project.build.sourceEncoding&gt;
    &lt;/properties&gt;
    &lt;dependencies&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.boot&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-boot-starter-web&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;com.alibaba.cloud.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-alibaba-starter-dashscope&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
&lt;!--        Redis向量数据库--&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;org.springframework.ai&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;spring-ai-starter-vector-store-redis&lt;/artifactId&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
        &lt;dependency&gt;
            &lt;groupId&gt;org.projectlombok&lt;/groupId&gt;
            &lt;artifactId&gt;lombok&lt;/artifactId&gt;
            &lt;optional&gt;true&lt;/optional&gt;
        &lt;/dependency&gt;
    &lt;/dependencies&gt;
&lt;/project&gt;
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>配置文件为：</p>
<pre><code class="language-properties">server.port=8011
# ?????????
server.servlet.encoding.charset=UTF-8
server.servlet.encoding.enabled=true
server.servlet.encoding.force=true

spring.application.name=saa11-Embed2vector

#springai ????config
spring.ai.dashscope.api-key=${aliQwen-apikey}
spring.ai.dashscope.chat.options.model=qwen-plus
spring.ai.dashscope.embedding.options.model=text-embedding-v3

# Redis Stack
spring.data.redis.host=192.168.220.128
spring.data.redis.port=6379
spring.data.redis.password=redis-stack
spring.data.redis.username=default
spring.ai.vectorstore.redis.initialize-schema=true
spring.ai.vectorstore.redis.index-name=custom-index
spring.ai.vectorstore.redis.prefix=custom-prefix
</code></pre>
</li>
<li>
<p>控制类</p>
<pre><code class="language-java">@RestController
public class Embed2VectorController {

    @Resource
    private EmbeddingModel embeddingModel;

    @Resource
    private VectorStore vectorStore;

    // 文本向量化
    @GetMapping("/embed2vector/text2embed")
    public EmbeddingResponse text2embed(@RequestParam("msg") String msg){

        // 使用全局模型配置
        //EmbeddingResponse embeddingResponse = embeddingModel.call(new EmbeddingRequest(List.of(msg),null);
        // 使用特定模型
        EmbeddingResponse embeddingResponse = embeddingModel.call(new EmbeddingRequest(List.of(msg),
                DashScopeEmbeddingOptions.builder().withModel("text-embedding-v3").build()));
        System.out.println(Arrays.toString(embeddingResponse.getResult().getOutput()));
        return embeddingResponse;
    }

    // 文本向量化后存入向量数据库RedisStack
    @GetMapping("/embed2vector/add")
    public void add(){
        List&lt;Document&gt; documents = List.of(
                new Document("i study LLM"),
                new Document("i love java")
        );
        vectorStore.add(documents);
    }

    // 从向量数据库RedisStack中查找。进行相似度查找
    @GetMapping("/embed2vector/get")
    public List getAll(@RequestParam("msg") String msg){
        SearchRequest searchRequest = SearchRequest.builder()
                .query(msg)
                .topK(10)
                .build();
        List&lt;Document&gt; documents = vectorStore.similaritySearch(searchRequest);
        System.out.println(documents);
        return documents;
    }
}
</code></pre>
</li>
</ol>
